name: quarto-ed
description: Browser-based Quarto editor with GitHub OAuth, live preview, and AI chat assistant.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: <TODO: set once in the pipeline's Review Apps config vars> Client ID for a dedicated 'quarto-ed (review apps)' GitHub OAuth App with a fixed callback URL.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: <TODO: set once in the pipeline's Review Apps config vars> Client secret for the dedicated review-app GitHub OAuth App.

SECRET_KEY.description: Session cookie signing key, auto-generated per review app.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: <TODO: set once in the pipeline's Review Apps config vars> Fernet key for encrypting GitHub tokens at rest. Generate with: python3 -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())". Heroku's secret generator does not produce a valid Fernet key, so this cannot be auto-generated.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional, enables the AI chat panel in review apps. <TODO: set once in the pipeline's Review Apps config vars if desired> (the production key can be reused).

AI_MODEL.description: Claude model ID for AI chat.

ALLOWED_GITHUB_USERS.description: Comma-separated GitHub usernames allowed to log in. Heroku review apps run unprivileged (no per-user OS sandbox -- see SECURITY.md), so this is the access boundary. <TODO: set to your GitHub username, or a small trusted list, in the pipeline's Review Apps config vars>.
